commercialPurpose: Close a lead-generation page with simple ownership and social links after testimonials without adding another heavy content block.
purposeLayer: Footer confirms closure, ownership, and social presence while preserving the conversion page pace.
anatomyLayer: Full-width color bar, left copyright text, right social icons, and no large link directory.
hierarchyLayer: Color closure first, copyright second, social icons third.
gridRhythmLayer: Single horizontal footer strip with two-end alignment inside a saturated band.
densityLimitLayer: Use one copyright line, 3-6 social links, and 0-2 utility links; avoid multi-column slabs.
originalityLayer: Learn minimal conversion footer; transform color, alignment, icon style, and legal/link depth.
usageRuleLayer: Use for focused landing pages where full footer navigation would dilute the CTA path.

sectionSilhouette: thin full-width color band with two-end micro content
compositionTension: simple utility closure after spacious testimonial proof
negativeSpaceShape: long horizontal color field with sparse endpoints
moduleScaleVariation: tiny text/icons inside a wide band
